description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Fishing Pole Trap. Cast the pole with 4...Ng4!? and go rook-hunting on the kingside.

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Ng4! 5.h3 h5! 6.hxg4 hxg4 — the pole is cast; the h8 rook will swing to h5.
drills.description: Black to play. White castled into the Berlin — throw the Fishing Pole with 4...Ng4!.
drills.explanation: The Fishing Pole: 4...Ng4!? provokes 5.h3, and then 5...h5! is the point — Black sacrifices the knight to open the h-file. After 6.hxg4 hxg4 White's kingside is in ruins: the knight on f3 must move, and Black follows with ...Rh5!, ...Qh4, and a raging attack. The 'pole' is the h-pawn, and White took the bait.
drills.name: Casting the Pole

drills.briefExplanation: 6...hxg4 7.Ne1 Qh4! — the queen joins the attack with mate threats on h1.
drills.description: Black to play. White took the knight — recapture and bring the queen into the attack.
drills.explanation: The follow-up to the sacrifice: 6...hxg4 opens the h-file, and after the forced 7.Ne1 (the f3 knight had to move) Black plays 7...Qh4! — threatening ...Qxh2# and ...Rh5. White's king is caught in a mating net with Black down only a knight for a crushing initiative. This is what the pole was fishing for.
drills.name: Reeling It In

name: Fishing Pole Trap — Black Tactics
